mutants.name: inplace_dp
mutants.desc: 2D gcd-pair DP updated in place (reads already-updated cells, so an element can be reused)

mutants.name: mobius_bad_empty
mutants.desc: Mobius inclusion-exclusion but only subtracts the both-empty case (forgets to remove pairs with exactly one empty side)

mutants.name: not_disjoint
mutants.desc: ignores disjointness: counts ordered pairs of nonempty subsequences with equal gcd as cnt[g]^2

mutants.name: offbyone_max
mutants.desc: Mobius solution with off-by-one: divisor counts / loops only go up to max(nums)-1

mutants.name: unordered_pairs
mutants.desc: counts unordered pairs {seq1, seq2} (divides the ordered count by 2)
